ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ROLT uses your location to record your rides and show where you are on the map.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ROLT always uses your location so it can keep recording your ride while the screen is off.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ROLT always uses your location so it can keep recording your ride while the screen is off.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ROLT accesses the photos you choose so you can add them to your profile, rides and suggested routes.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: ROLT uses the camera so you can add photos to your routes and rides.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ROLT adds images to your library so you can save your profile card.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: ROLT uses your phone's motion sensors to measure your lean angle while you ride.
